speaker: Secretary-General
text: Thank you for accepting this assignment.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The Offshore Wind Energy in the Conan Sea project is one of the largest infrastructure projects Arcadia has ever attempted.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The proposed offshore wind park could provide nearly half of the electricity required by our industries.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: It may also power a large part of our railway network and reduce our dependence on imported fossil fuels.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: This project is central to Arcadia’s commitments under the Paris Agreement and the Sustainable Development Goals.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: However, constructing the wind park will not be simple.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The Conan Sea is already heavily used by many different groups.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The government has adopted a principle of equitable and multifunctional maritime use.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: In simple terms: the sea is limited, and everyone wants to use it.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The wind park must therefore balance economic, ecological, and social interests.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: Your decisions will affect biodiversity, trade, employment, food production, and climate policy.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: You must also ensure Arcadia remains compliant with international law obligations.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: A poorly planned project could damage ecosystems, harm local communities, and expose Arcadia to legal consequences.
